data.one_liner: Check and disable battery optimizations and auto-start settings on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to check native and manufacturer-specific battery optimizations and auto-start permissions. Displays custom dialogs and guides users to disable these restrictions on devices like Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo, Huawei, and OnePlus.
use_when: Your background services or alarms are being killed by aggressive Android battery management
You need to guide users through manufacturer-specific settings to keep your app running
avoid_when: Your app does not rely on background execution or alarms
You only need general device information without modifying power settings
strengths: Supports manufacturer-specific optimizations for vendors like Xiaomi, Samsung, Oppo, and Huawei
Provides helper methods to check all battery optimizations at once
weaknesses: Cannot programmatically determine if the user actually changed manufacturer-specific settings
data.setup_notes: Requires Android platform setup and appropriate permissions to show battery optimization dialogs.

alternatives.name: battery_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use battery_plus if you only need to read general battery state and level rather than modifying power optimization settings.
